title: नेपाल भाषा र नेपाली भाषामा कारक व्यवस्था {Case study Arrangement of Nepal Bhasa (Newari Language) and Nepali Language}
nepali: प्रस्तुत ‘नेपाल भाषा र नेपाली भाषामा कारकको व्यवस्था’ शीर्षकको लेखको मूल उद्देश्य नेपाल तथा नेपाली भाषाका कारक व्यवस्थाको तुलना गर्नु हो। यहाँ नेपाल भाषाका सामग्री कीर्तिपुरमा बोलिने नेपाल भाषाबाट उद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोटका आधारमा सङ्कलन गरिएको छ भने नेपाली भाषाका सामग्री सङ्कलनका लागि पुस्तकालीय स्रोतबाट गरिएको छ । यसका लागि नेपाली भाषामा कारक सम्बन्धी लेखिएका पुस्तकलाई आधार मानिएको छ । नेपाल भाषा र नेपाली भाषाका कारकहरू प्रयोग भएका वाक्यहरू उल्लेख गरी विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । पुस्तकालयीय कार्यबाट तथ्य सङ्कलन गरिएको यस लेखमा वर्णनात्मक विधिको उपयोग गरिएको छ । नेपाल र नेपाली दुवै भाषामा अर्थका दृष्टिले छ प्रकारका कारकहरू रहेका छन् भने रूपका दृष्टिले नेपाली र नेपाल भाषामा सरल र तिर्यक् दुवै प्रकारका कारकहरू छन्। नेपाली भाषामा वचन, आदर र विभक्तियुक्त कारक तिर्यक् रुपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ भने नेपाल भाषामा पनि वचन, आदर र विभक्तियुक्त कारक नै तिर्यक् कारकका रूपमा प्रयोग भएको पाइन्छ ।
american_english: The main objective of the article titled 'Case Arrangement in Nepal Bhasa and Nepali Language' is to compare the case systems of Nepal Bhasa and Nepali. Here, the Nepal Bhasa material was collected from the Nepal Bhasa spoken in Kirtipur, on the basis of purposive sampling, while the Nepali material was collected from library sources. For this purpose, books written on case in Nepali have been taken as the basis. The cases of Nepal Bhasa and Nepali have been analyzed by citing the sentences in which they are used. This article, in which the facts were collected through library work, uses a descriptive method. In both Nepal Bhasa and Nepali there are three types of cases from the point of view of meaning, whereas from the point of view of form, Nepali and Nepal Bhasa both have simple and oblique cases. In Nepali, cases inflected for number, respect and case endings are used in oblique form, and in Nepal Bhasa as well, cases inflected for number, respect and case endings are found to be used as oblique cases.

informal_english: The present article, titled 'Case Arrangement in Nepal Bhasa and Nepali Language', has as its main objective a comparison of the case systems of Nepal Bhasa and Nepali. Here, the Nepal Bhasa material has been collected from the Nepal Bhasa spoken in Kirtipur on the basis of purposive sampling, whereas the material for the Nepali language has been collected from library sources. For this, the books written on case in Nepali have been taken as the basis. The cases of Nepal Bhasa and Nepali have been analysed by citing the sentences in which they are used. In this present article, the facts have been collected through library work and the descriptive method has been employed. In both the languages, namely Nepal Bhasa and Nepali, there are three types of cases from the point of view of meaning, while from the point of view of form, both simple and oblique cases are found in Nepali and Nepal Bhasa. In the Nepali language, cases having number, respect and case-endings are used in oblique form, and in Nepal Bhasa also, cases having number, respect and case-endings are found to be used as oblique cases.
translator_notes: 'Nepal' in the Nepali refers to Nepal Bhasa (Newari) as short for 'Nepal bhasa'; rendered accordingly. Purposive sampling (उद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोट) kept. Ordered sentence by sentence as in source.
